textbookText: Willebrord Snell was a 17thcentury Dutch astronomer and mathematician. One of his greatest findings in the world of science is law of refraction. Snell brought about a major revolution when he developed a new method to calculate the mathematical function ‘Pi’, which led to tremendous development in the field of mathematics. Snell had published several of his works; the two most acknowledged and acclaimed are ‘Eratosthenes Batavus’ and ‘Tiphys Batavus’. He also worked in the field of astronomy.
